subject: philosophy
intro: Philosophy leads to paid work built on rigorous reasoning — arguing cases in law, resolving disputes between parties, editing other people's arguments into publishable form, and teaching the discipline itself.

roles.title: Lawyers
roles.what: Represent clients in criminal and civil litigation and other legal proceedings, draw up legal documents, and manage or advise clients on legal transactions across a range of specialisms.
roles.where: The argumentation unit — validity, soundness, fallacies and reasoning from premises to conclusions — is the engine of legal argument; the epistemology unit's scrutiny of what we can know mirrors weighing evidence at trial.

roles.title: Arbitrators, Mediators, and Conciliators
roles.what: Facilitate negotiation and conflict resolution through dialogue, resolving disputes outside the court system by the mutual consent of the parties involved.
roles.where: Training in identifying the structure of an argument and its flaws — circularity, question-begging, contradictions — is exactly what a mediator does when parties trade reasons; ethics units supply the fairness framework.

roles.title: Editors
roles.what: Plan, coordinate and revise written material for publication — reviewing proposals and drafts, testing the strength of arguments and shaping text so it holds together for readers.
roles.where: The argument-analysis unit — extracting premises and conclusions from prose, spotting fallacies — trains the critical reading editors apply line by line; the essay-writing discipline shapes manuscripts to length and purpose.

roles.title: Philosophy and Religion Teachers, Postsecondary
roles.what: Teach philosophy, religion and theology courses at colleges and universities — leading seminars on knowledge, reality and value, and researching and publishing in their own area of philosophy.
roles.where: The syllabus's epistemology spine — Gettier cases, scepticism, the limits of knowledge — and the canon from Plato and Descartes to Berkeley are the standard first-year course content these teachers deliver.
